articles.title: Parrish, Crombie kick off Mississauga mayoral campaign as race for city hall heats up
articles.summary: The race for the top job at city hall is heating up in Mississauga as two high profile candidates launched their campaigns on Sunday

articles.title: Motorcyclist fatally injured in Scarborough crash
articles.summary: A motorcyclist has died following a crash in Scarborough. Toronto police say a motorcycle was travelling eastbound on Eglinton Avenue and a car was going westbound and attempting to make a left-hand turn at McCowan Road when the crash occurred just before 6 p.m. Sunday night. The motorcyclist was transported to a nearby trauma centre. […]

articles.title: 'I never felt the pressure': Guerrero Jr. finally hits first homer of season at Rogers Centre in win over Os
articles.summary: For the first time this season, Vladimir Guerrero Jr. has homered north of the border. The 2023 Home Run Derby champion, Guerrero connected off Baltimore's Trevor Rogers in the fifth inning of Sunday's 8-1 win.

articles.title: Guerrero hits first homer of season at Rogers Centre as Blue Jays crush Orioles
articles.summary: Vladimir Guerrero Jr. smacked his first homer at home this season in an 8-1 win against the Baltimore Orioles on Sunday.

articles.title: 17th annual Cruisin' For A Cure car show held in Brampton
articles.summary: The 17th annual Cruisin' For A Cure Canada car show was held in Brampton, Ont., Sunday. The event offered free prostate cancer tests for men over the age of 40 and also raised awareness of the importance of early detection. CBC's Tyler Cheese has the story.

articles.title: 11 names added to MADD Ontario monument for impaired driving victims
articles.summary: Families of victims, community members, police officers and survivors of impaired driving gathered in Brampton Saturday for a ceremony, where 11 new names were added to an Ontario memorial that honours victims of alcohol and drug-involved crashes.

articles.title: Two uniforms, one deadly morning: A Mississauga firefighter and former soldier reflects on 9/11
articles.summary: Twenty-five years after the terror attacks of Sept. 11, 2001, Shawn Matheson recalls viewing them through two different lenses: as a firefighter in Mississauga, Ont., and as a Canadian reservist. The tragedy would take him to funerals at Ground Zero, foreshadow the war in Afghanistan and reveal the lasting emotional cost borne by soldiers and first responders alike.

articles.title: Reliance on visual inspections may have played role in GO train derailment at Union Station: report
articles.summary: A new report has found an overreliance on visual inspections of the train tracks may have contributed to the derailment of a GO Transit train at Toronto's Union Station that disrupted commuter travel for days earlier this year.

articles.title: Stellantis signs MOU with Canadian armoured vehicle maker on potential sale of Brampton, Ont., plant
articles.summary: Automaker Stellantis says it has signed a memorandum of understanding with Canadian armoured vehicle maker Roshel on a potential sale of its idled Brampton, Ont., assembly plant.
